run.name: Prepare pinned qctl renderer
run.command:
set -euo pipefail
tool_dir="${QQQ_TEMPLATE_TOOL_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/qqq-template-renderer}"
maven_repo="${QQQ_TEMPLATE_MAVEN_REPO:-$HOME/.m2/repository}"
if [[ ! -d "$tool_dir/.git" ]]; then
  git init "$tool_dir"
  git -C "$tool_dir" remote add origin https://github.com/QRun-IO/qctl.git
  git -C "$tool_dir" fetch --depth=1 origin d84a5783bf09c58e42ba72203247f20bd5779302
  git -C "$tool_dir" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
fi
test "$(git -C "$tool_dir" rev-parse HEAD)" = d84a5783bf09c58e42ba72203247f20bd5779302
# Build the immutable, already-qualified renderer, not another copy of the consumer.
if [[ ! -f "$tool_dir/qctl-qqq/target/qctl-qqq-0.2.1.jar" || ! -f "$maven_repo/io/qrun/qctl/qctl-qqq/0.2.1/qctl-qqq-0.2.1.pom" ]]; then
  mvn -B -ntp -f "$tool_dir/pom.xml" -Dmaven.repo.local="$maven_repo" -pl qctl-qqq -am install -DskipTests
fi
mvn -B -ntp -f "$tool_dir/pom.xml" -Dmaven.repo.local="$maven_repo" -pl qctl-qqq dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile="$tool_dir/classpath.txt"

run.name: Render the exact template checkout without hooks
